newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Bomb explodes in Nigerian army bus, one dead.
newsitem.headline: Bomb explodes in Nigerian army bus, one dead.

text.p: A bomb exploded inside a Nigerian army bus in Lagos on Tuesday, killing one person and wounding at least 15, military sources said.
They said the bomb went off in the bus carrying soldiers within an army camp in the Surulere district of Lagos and the area had been cordoned off by security authorities.
"Investigations have commenced in the bomb blast this morning around Albati barracks," said one army source, who asked not to be identified.
It was the third blast in Lagos since December and followed a warning by the United States that bomb attacks could take place at Nigerian airports in the last two weeks of December.
Two bombs exploded within days last month targetting the military administrator of Lagos state Colonel Muhammed Marwa, a close aide of military ruler General Sani Abacha.
No one has claimed responsibility but the authorities blame the string of similar explosions in politically volatile Nigeria on the exiled opposition.
